20134.long_desc:
This Illuminated Sanwa 30MM Clone Push Button is compatible with Game Wizard Extreme and Japanese arcade machines made by Taito, Sega and Namco.  It comes DC 5V/12V LED in each button.  Light will glow under the plunger and through the translucent plastic body.  It also features a slightly convex plunger and snap-in installation (can be mounted in material with a thickness from 2 to 5 mm).

Each Illuminated Sanwa 30MM Clone Push Button contains a non-clicking microswitch which is capable to withstand at least 5,000,000 presses. Other than installing the buttons into an arcade machine, you can replace the stock buttons on most of the home console fightsticks. You can also use the buttons to build your own custom controller. This size button would be suitable for fire buttons or equivalent.

Available in a choice of 5 colors - red, green, yellow, white, or blue
